title: Find the IP address of a domain using nslookup
summary: Use nslookup to find the IP address associated with a website or domain name. This checks what your computer's default DNS server returns for that name.

steps.explain: Query the default name server for the IP address (A record) of the specified domain.

placeholders.name: DOMAIN
placeholders.description: The domain name to look up, e.g. example.com

steps.expect: The command outputs the IP address(es) associated with the domain.
